description: This file implements the Pattern class and PatternList class for matching string patterns with limited regex-like syntax, including wildcards and path boundaries, used in the gn build system.

classes.name: Pattern
classes.description: Represents a string pattern with limited regex features, supporting matching operations.

classes.name: PatternList
classes.description: A collection of Pattern objects with methods to match strings or values.

methods.name: Pattern::Pattern
methods.description: Constructor that parses a pattern string into subranges.

methods.name: Pattern::MatchesString
methods.description: Checks if a given string matches the pattern.

methods.name: Pattern::RecursiveMatch
methods.description: Recursively matches a string against the pattern subranges.

methods.name: PatternList::SetFromValue
methods.description: Initializes pattern list from a Value object.

methods.name: PatternList::MatchesString
methods.description: Checks if any pattern in the list matches the string.
